palisades.text: Major props to Squaw for harvesting and keeping Gold Coast park and Shirley open
palisades.author: Tahowaiian

palisades.text: Groomers early running great.  Sticky afternoon
palisades.author: Tahowaiian

heavenly.text: Back open! Just California trail off Tamarack but still fun
heavenly.author: Tahowaiian

heavenly.text: Awesome day on the slope in a spring like weather on Apr 3rd. Just one day with no lines and awesome weather was enough to remember the season for good.
heavenly.author: Jitenski

heavenly.text: Ridge is fading fast.  Mountain crews did a great job with what nature offered.  Shout-out to Tahowaiian, thanks for solid first hand reports all season.
heavenly.author: Neffer

heavenly.text: Light dusting. Rain to bottom of powderbowl
heavenly.author: Tahowaiian

heavenly.text: Beautiful bluebird day. No lines. 10am to 12 pm Spring skiing snow. No ice (by east coast standards). Only runs off Canyon and Sky Express but fun day. Ridge top to bottom was in the best shape.
Just high 5 and Ridge run and Maggie's.
heavenly.author: Tahowaiian

heavenly.text: They’re done up there for the season. Was there last week. 68F on the mountain. Solid groomed ice in the morning then mashed potatoes by noon. Snow is melting in droves. Creeks are roaring below. They won’t make Easter at this rate.
heavenly.author: Bill J

kirkwood.text: Slushy sticky some rocks near base
kirkwood.author: Tahowaiian

kirkwood.text: Slushy and some rocks showing on piste
kirkwood.author: Tahowaiian

kirkwood.text: Icy morning but softens by noon. Coverage still good
kirkwood.author: Tahowaiian

kirkwood.text: Icy morning to slightly sticky slush after
kirkwood.author: Tahowaiian

kirkwood.text: Firm icy morning turns to good sierra soft serve afternoon not sticky
kirkwood.author: Tahowaiian

kirkwood.text: Beautiful spring sking with weather in the 70's! Lots of powder and the entire front side is open. No lines, great conditions. Get it in!
kirkwood.author: Lance Yudkin@TheLuxSkier

kirkwood.text: Deep but variable. Some mashed potatoes and sticky down low
kirkwood.author: Tahowaiian

kirkwood.text: Excellent coverage and good snow conditions.
kirkwood.author: Tahowaiian

sugar-bowl.text: Definitely late Spring skiing and tee-shirt weather.  I predict Judah will close within 1 week, Jerome  1-2 weeks.  Disney is still fair and somewhat better than Mt. Lincoln.  Best come soon.  No ice anywhere though, it’s too warm for that. Heavy wet corn snow and in the 60’s today.
sugar-bowl.author: P Daddy

sugar-bowl.text: Good skiing. Slushy in the noon

Mt. Judah was icy up top, Jerome Hill was good as usual.  Mt Lincoln and Disney also were enjoyable.  Not the best conditions, but sunny, warm and still fun with small crowds.  Only Mt Lincoln will hold good snow until mid April.
sugar-bowl.author: P Daddy

sugar-bowl.text: straight blizzard but i’m the goat so it doesn’t matter
sugar-bowl.author: lebron james

sugar-bowl.text: Fun day.  Definitely spring like but they do such a great job grooming. Very impressed
sugar-bowl.author: Ace

sugar-bowl.text: Conditions better than expected. Some lovely groomed slopes and glorious sunshine. View from the impressive new Village Lodge deck
sugar-bowl.author: Phil P

northstar.text: Hard in the morning, softens up around lunch, slush in the afternoon. Lots of brown spots on backside.
northstar.author: Carissa M

northstar.text: Lots of snow!! Plenty of powder for your enjoyment! Plenty of soft groomed runs also. Was a beautiful Friday but busy, too busy for my style but it is “ski week”
northstar.author: K Roy

northstar.text: Great day today at Northstar. Yesterday was primo after 4 inches of snow early morning after groom machines rolled. Mountain is in pretty good shape. Early groomers on the front side are nice! Back is a little more crusty. POW in tres was better than expected. A few obstacles in a few areas but 98 percent of groomers are good. More snow coming!!!!
northstar.author: K Roy

northstar.text: Groomed runs are a blast in the morning.  Do they need snow?  Yes. But it is skiable and fun.
northstar.author: Mario

northstar.text: Front side stayed pretty soft today. Back side was icy. Need snow, just like the entire west coast.
Snow is stable, although some areas have melted and re-froze, causing harder surfaces.
northstar.author: Jaason

northstar.text: Great Weather not so great conditions
northstar.author: Tampa Steve

mt-rose.text: Perfect conditions. Lake view only lift open with wizard currently
mt-rose.author: Chris P

mt-rose.text: 3 lifts opens. The blues are fine, not too icy- but the blacks aren’t much fun. Still… good to get some skiing in. No queues
mt-rose.author: Chris

mt-rose.text: Great snow. Visibility was bad by the end of the day but that was due to the storm. The trees finally have snow to ski through!
mt-rose.author: Brittney

mt-rose.text: Beautiful conditions & the best groomed corduroy runs!
Beautiful ski conditions on Fri. Light snowing & wonderful powder on Saturday!!
Slide Bowl just opened today, most trails are now open except chutes.
mt-rose.author: Big bull

mt-rose.text: Snow is groomed on Carson bowl and decent early in the day. With almost no other resorts open it’s crowded with not only family but also ski teams from around the lake.
mt-rose.author: Cork dog

sierra-at-tahoe.text: Decent at Sierra on Friday the 6th.    A bit thin in places but the crew doing a good job with what they have.    Hunted for decent snow and found it on upper and lower main and beaver of all places.  Snow making there helps.    The season is winding down it appears.   Pic is westbowl
sierra-at-tahoe.author: Matt

sierra-at-tahoe.text: A little slushy out there as of 11am it’s still cold so there isn’t accelerated melting but there are also sprinkles out today. Overall it’s decent given the rains last week wiped out the recent snow gains.
sierra-at-tahoe.author: lynz0r

sierra-at-tahoe.text: ~6” of fresh snow on the mountain, started kind of wet and heavy but got better throughout day. Visibility became a big issue later in the day (foggy). Castle was fantastic
Sugary & icy spots in the morning, wet & chewy in the afternoon. Honestly pretty good conditions for it being 49°F (t-shirt skiing

Another great day at Sierra.   Conditions are spotty but groomers are great 80% of the time.  Find a run you like and stick with it.  Today was Dogwood.   Amazing conditions on west bowl for that run.   If the mountain was groomed closer to the morning time the snow was amazing.  This place will be excellent with a little more snow.  But today was great, blue skies and friendly staff
sierra-at-tahoe.author: Matt

sierra-at-tahoe.text: Skiied Monday (MLK Day), beautiful day!  Coverage is a bit thin in spots but overall groomers were great.  Surprisingly not that crowded.
Pretty icy but the groomers are great. Can’t complain at all
Snow was great today.   Blue skies.  Not terribly windy.   Light snow and stayed frozen most of the day.   Groomers were amazing with fantastic staff all over the mountain.
sierra-at-tahoe.author: Matt

sierra-at-tahoe.text: snow has been lovely all weekend a bit warm put for my taste but a great day regardless
sierra-at-tahoe.author: Kaci

sierra-at-tahoe.text: Super thin snow be safe rock board day lol
sierra-at-tahoe.author: Mojo

mammoth.text: The snow is great. All time spring conditions. Warm days slushy snow and cold beer. Mammoth is the best
mammoth.author: G

mammoth.text: Nice and slushy, some rocks popping out tho
mammoth.author: Bos dude yt

mammoth.text: Partly cloudy keeps the snow fast.
mammoth.author: Tahowaiian

mammoth.text: Classic sierra spring corn.  Great coverage.  Open from chair 10 to 12
mammoth.author: Tahowaiian

mammoth.text: Great snow. A little icy in the morning then great rest of day. A little cold and windy. Felt like winter ski day
mammoth.author: Cynthia

mammoth.text: Definitely more bare spots than expected based on the recent storm.
Fabulous conditions even before the storm!  And yes we did climax.
mammoth.author: Sendy Savage

mt-baker.text: Wednesday night rain put a 2inch crust cap on much of the mountain which got a few inches Thursday. Night skiing should be a good time.
Rained last night then froze over, it’s chunky. Wait for snow
mt-baker.author: M

mt-baker.text: Rained in the morning then snowed a bit before noon. Had some pillows of snow around the mountain from throughout the week
mt-baker.author: peterzinho.c

mt-baker.text: Best part of the day. Sun break top of Lift 5. Mostly cloudy, bit of wet/sleety snow in the afternoon.
mt-baker.author: Munchie

mt-baker.text: Soft snow at the summit, a bit wet at the base, but lots of it everywhere.  Great snow day!
good weekday skiing today sunny in the morning. Go oops t a little cloudy in the afternoon but the light was still good. 3 inches or so of nice loose snow on top of packed great skiing.
mt-baker.author: The Sherm

mt-baker.text: Best day at Baker! Tons of snow fell yesterday and overnight. Roads are clear. Deep, dry powder.
mt-baker.author: Hunter

mt-baker.text: Rain at base to rain/snow mix mid mountain to snow at summits.  Lodge was half full at lunch. Zero lift lines.

crystal.text: Mashed potatoes but still fun. Lapping Forest Queen is fun. Definitely spots where coverage is wearing thin but nothing unmanageable. Definitely worth getting the high temp wax on as you see folks involuntarily slowing in places. Worth coming up this weekend though next weekend will be less favorable.
Great and unexpected bonus quasi-pow day.  Decent snow up high, and bit heavy and sticky down low.  Take what we can get with this tough season.
crystal.author: Jimmy G

crystal.text: It was an ice rink fir the first couple of hours. Softening up a little, but not a lot.
3”-4” low density snow on top of a skating rink was where it was at today.  Looking forward to the mega dumpage in the forecast for Wednesday-Friday
crystal.author: Jimmy G

crystal.text: 15 minute wait at queens, few icy patches on the steeper portions but overall an enjoyable day on the mountain. Thin cover toward the base.
Very nice sun out. Good fun on forest queen runs! Some ice under the snow in spots but downhill and queens run were fun
crystal.author: SB

crystal.text: Great morning on 01/07/26 with 15”+ of pow across the mountain.  Still sharks lurking by mid afternoon once the pow was tracked out thanks to low snowfall thus far.
crystal.author: Jimmy G

crystal.text: Thin wet below midway. Bluebird tho. Better than no snow

stevens-pass.text: Snow was great and first half of the day was a blue bird. Best day I've seen at Stevens this season!
stevens-pass.author: Ryan

stevens-pass.text: Yesterday was great for groomers, later in the day off groom softened up a little and was very fun.
March 26. Brooks chair. This is spring? I’ll take it.
stevens-pass.author: Kevin

stevens-pass.text: It’s a dirty slush pit out there. Anything off the groomers is nearly impossible to ski. The groomers are like big Slurpee‘s with occasional open holes with water below. None of the top of the mountain is open. Apparently there’s not much good weather in the forecast.
stevens-pass.author: Doug Darche

stevens-pass.text: Wed night: Lots o' snow since Sunday visit. When the sun went down, more snow started to fly, freshies each time off the lift. Felt like new 1/2" every run. No lift lines to speak of. Plenty of hootin' and hollering on the way down. Backside, 7th Heaven, Tye Mill all closed.
stevens-pass.author: SkiHound

stevens-pass.text: It was mostly good but the coverage was not too good. At least they got about 5” the day before, but got skied out.
stevens-pass.author: Ethan

stevens-pass.text: Snowing all night and short lines made for the best night skiing so far this season. Stayed around 30F
stevens-pass.author: Brian Geppert

stevens-pass.text: The warm temperatures melted the grooming overnight in most places so it was thick snow, not quite slushy. By 11am it was 43F. Rather disappointed that they closed half of skyline for a race camp. That closure meant you could not easily ski from SwineSpine down Hog Heaven. And the backside was closed. Good thing I was only skiing for a couple hours. At least it was sunny :)
stevens-pass.author: Brian Geppert

mt-bachelor.text: Skied 3 hours on Tuesday April 14th. Limited runs available. Nice snow coverage generally, some ice on some runs and on other runs variable snow with crusty soft snow to turn in.  Not bad but looking forward to checking out the snow that fell today!
Summit is finally open. Good coverage and spring snow. Got a foot of pow last Thursday.
mt-bachelor.author: Powpow

mt-bachelor.text: It’s Dumping out here!! One of the best skiing I’ve ever experienced

Slushy and mushy. Northwest and Summit closed. Outback is fun early pm but a lot of stuff exposed and getting worse by the day. Especially on Kangaroo and parts of Boomerang. So so day on the slopes is still better than a day in the office.
All lifts on hold as of 9:23 AM 3/12
Windy, light snow. Red chair and Pine on hold for strong winds. Skyliner opening
Coverage is good. Obstacles are starting to disappear. Was cold today and snowing making for some butter
mt-bachelor.author: Paul

mt-bachelor.text: Beautiful Day! Snow was surprisingly good, however coverage was limited.
Awesome considering what we were expecting.  Little ice….,just packed snow.
mt-bachelor.author: Paul

telluride.text: 11” of heavy power. Good snow off of lift 5. Great day considering…
telluride.author: Gary

telluride.text: Went up on the 24 of march and it was warm. it had the best time!!
telluride.author: Ri

telluride.text: Finally a little snow. Not bad on the upper runs. Mash potatoes on the lower runs.

Well at least it’s not crowded. Snow disappeared fast over the last couple of days. Lots of terrain closed in the last few days. Upper mountain alpine is closed, trees are done for the season - basically just the groomers off Chairs 4 & 5, while chair 6 is the only chair with open black terrain. Lots of slush and sunshine, but at least it’s beautiful.
telluride.author: Vol

telluride.text: The snow is disappearing fast. Our condo was ski-in/out two days ago, now a walk through the mud. Nordic trail pictured below. Snow shoe terrain is still good and hiking trails are great!
telluride.author: Spring Break Family

telluride.text: Icy morning and slushy afternoons. But the views are still amazing
telluride.author: Gary

telluride.text: Icy mornings, slushy afternoons. Not sure how long it can hold up in these temperatures!
telluride.author: Gary

telluride.text: Tough out there.. leaving a day early due to the conditions and warming temps. A lot of dirt patches and visible mountain biking trails.

Skied a full day Saturday on classic freeze-thaw spring conditions. Ungroomed slopes and steeps are thin and scratchy. Groomers are good after they soften up. Best snow is 10-2 but you need to find the soft stuff. Minimal lift lines and plenty to do in town if you finish your day early.
telluride.author: Mike

telluride.text: Telluride snow is holding up but by 2:30 pm the lower Mtn snow has patches of mashed potatoes … but the blue bird days make up for any snow loss, skiing with only glove liners everyone getting the rosy glow of spring skiing … here you see the ‘crowded’ conditions here in the final days of season, why wait?
telluride.author: Jcp3dc

crested-butte.text: Very warm here. Temperatures in the upper 60’s and low 70’s at the base. Very soft slush snow. Good news is that there are no lift lines!
crested-butte.author: Bill

crested-butte.text: Fantastic day. Storm brought great powder to cover the previous ice and lines weren’t bad. Over the day it got tossed around and made for some bumps but the packed powder was still better than the ice. Stayed icy at the bottoms but that’s the breaks kid. We’ll see what Saturday brings.
crested-butte.author: Okieboarder

crested-butte.text: Icy garbage this morning. Legit worst ski conditions I've experienced in years. The only whoots and hollers were coming from the east-coasters
crested-butte.author: Luke O

crested-butte.text: Great bluebird day. Snow in very good shape. Short lines.
crested-butte.author: Dandrews

crested-butte.text: Over 12 inches after snowing non-stop all day. Has softened everything up nicely!
I skiied christmas 2025 with my family, good runs definitely going to go back, the weather looks like some good powder lately
crested-butte.author: Gage G

crested-butte.text: Just returned from my annual 3 day trip with my son.  CB is doing the best they can, but it’s pretty bad.  They have used their water allowance so no more snow making.  A lot of the runs that are reported as open are not skiable—just moguls and crud.  There’s a few decent green runs on the front side, Paradise Bowl was acceptable , and Prospect was ok.  Check for groomed trails—open doesn’t mean you want to be there.  It’s too warm so conditions really deteriorate in the afternoon. PRAY 4 SNOW
crested-butte.author: Blue Corduroy

crested-butte.text: Not much snow but CB did a great job with what they have been given.  I’m an older beginner and my wife hung back with me on the groomed greens and blues.  We had a great day!  We did see lots of grass and bare spots on the other trails.  Good uncrowded time for novices.  And the mountain is gorgeous as usual.  Great day to be outside seeing God’s artistry!
crested-butte.author: Focus Realty

aspen-highlands.text: Best last weekend..!!  Amazing snow.!!!!  Happy holy weekend..!!!
aspen-highlands.author: DonkyKikon

aspen-highlands.text: Still a few runs open at Aspen. 65 degrees and Sunny.
14” in the last 48 hours. This was yesterday Friday on Sam’s Knob. Sunny today and for the rest of the week with no lineups :)
aspen-highlands.author: Bob Styan

steamboat.text: Steamboat became a Winter Wonderland overnight! 10" of new powder and still snowing!  This is an answer to many prayers by this fam from TX!
steamboat.author: Jesko Fam

steamboat.text: This place only grooms a few runs on the whole mountain. Don’t recommend unless all is groomed
Lots of sketchy coverage on the mountain. I’m surprised some parts of the mountain are open. Just not enough snow and it’s quickly melting with 60 degree temperatures.
steamboat.author: S

steamboat.text: As someone else mentioned, sweet spot is 10-2pm. Any earlier is straight up hard pack. Mashed potatoes all over, be prepared to slash some slush. Ikon pass only IMO, don’t even think about paying for a lift ticket. Not enough coverage/runs to make it worth it. Snow has been rapidly melting, 68 degrees up top, 75 degrees at the base.
steamboat.author: Ric

steamboat.text: Plenty of good skiing 3/12-3/14. Crunchy in the am, best window for the upper half was 10am-2pm. Bottom is a mess, will be interesting to see if they can keep it covered without fresh snow soon.
steamboat.author: Andy S

steamboat.text: Not great snow definitely slushy even at 1:30 really warm and sunny
Snowed all day, over 8 inches up top, great day
steamboat.author: Alex

steamboat.text: Steamboat does a great job keeping the snow they have

Colder than the last few days. Groomed runs were fast and getting icy. Started off at 28F. In town it was 55F. The two black diamond groomed runs were icy but also has tree or shrub tops poking through so you had to be wary.
steamboat.author: Brian Geppert

vail.text: Just two days away from closing There’s 3 solid runs off chairs 3 & 4 still. Get it while it lasts! Today was good but avoid Eagle Banh & Chair 2.  Only ride up and download Gondola 1 if I were you.
vail.author: Erin Woodward

vail.text: Only option remaining is download. Lines pretty long at #3 & #4. There’s no feasible way this mtn makes it to April 5, unless we get the predicated 12” today and 5” and 5”.  Hanging on by a thread. Still had fun in today’s rain and 45 degrees just going with the flow. There is flow - puddles and patches and slush.
vail.author: Erin Woodward

vail.text: Looking down at midvail from Swingsville. Hope for snow this week!
vail.author: Brian

vail.text: Just a few trails open now.  Its melting FAST
vail.author: Mark

vail.text: Skied Vail today, wasn’t horrible.  They closed Riva #6 for the season. Chairs #2, #3, #4 still spinning. Ramshorn, Hunky and top to bottom of Eagle are shockingly fun. They’ve been pushing snow around and borrowing from closed areas. Kudos to the snow team.
vail.author: Erin Woodward

vail.text: You can get spring skiing around chairs 2,3 and 4. I skied the past three days and had a blast. It is what it is but there is still fun to be had. With that being said, it changes a lot each day. I’ll be surprised if they can stay open another week to 10 days.
vail.author: Garland

vail.text: Chair 11 is closed alongside with game creek bowl. Still some snow around the chair 2,3,4 and the gondola.

breckenridge.text: I was here a couple weeks ago and it snowed heavily in the morning then melted later I would ski as early as possible the snow is a bit icy but it has a peak moment
Low temps, fresh snow, couldn't be happier
breckenridge.author: Mark

breckenridge.text: Looks like it will be a great day!
breckenridge.author: Mommy & me

breckenridge.text: Long lines at Tbar and crusty in the bowls. Only saw two blue runs open, Northstar and Pioneer - super crowded and slushy bumps but fast with the cooler temps. No lines at the bottom today.
breckenridge.author: Amy

breckenridge.text: The park has plenty of snow ❄️
breckenridge.author: Mark

breckenridge.text: Snow is grippy in the AM - first hour was pretty empty
breckenridge.author: Jimbo

breckenridge.text: Yikes!!! Dirt rock skiing at its best!
breckenridge.author: MFSMITH

breckenridge.text: Every run on peak 9. American and Eldora parks still open. Last Sunday, snow coverage was much better. Crazy the loss in 5 days.
breckenridge.author: Potatoline

breckenridge.text: Photo is based on of peak 8 yesterday. Hard work especially at the bottom. Reasonable snow off Springmeier and Park Lane. Many runs closed. Soft by 11.30. Peak 9 and 10 deteriorating rapidly - word on the street is Peak 9 and 10 are closing after Sunday.
breckenridge.author: UKSkier

arapahoe-basin.text: Started icy, softened up with some sun, all fun. 2026 was a rough year, but years like this make us appreciate the good ones. Nothing is guaranteed in life. Count your blessings and see everyone next year!!!
arapahoe-basin.author: Alex B

arapahoe-basin.text: Pleasantly surprised by the quite workable conditions today. They’ve done an amazing job moving snow around to keep the few remaining runs in decent shape.
arapahoe-basin.author: Mommy & me

arapahoe-basin.text: Overall decent day, especially up top. Starts getting slushy by 1pm. Coverage is meting fast!
arapahoe-basin.author: Dawn Howard

arapahoe-basin.text: Hard chalk….  But for $50 its worth the experience.
arapahoe-basin.author: Greg from Jax Ski Club

arapahoe-basin.text: Very thin at places. Beavers side was also kinda sketchy. Lower runs were fun.
Windy and lots of squalls at the top. Most trails or pretty powdery.
arapahoe-basin.author: Mason

snowbird.text: Lower Collin's chair today 4/22/2026! Nuff seen! Get here or please don't
snowbird.author: Matty McC

snowbird.text: This place should be renamed “Polebird” you have to pole up into many lifts, and odd places on the runs.  Peruvian area is holding snow amazingly for after tax day.   Gadzoom was rough.
snowbird.author: TDLL

snowbird.text: Good coverage, choppy in a lot of areas but pretty smooth in others! We thought conditions for this time of year were great!
snowbird.author: Anastasia

snowbird.text: Good coverage up top.  Skinny at the bottom.
snowbird.author: Chris

snowbird.text: Back of the mountain Birds Nest was all ice in the beginning. Very slushy snow at the base. Even with the snow the conditions aren’t the best with ivy trails
Began as bluebird day. Beautiful. Clouds rolled in at 1.
snowbird.author: D J Trumpf. April 3.

snowbird.text: Low visibility, frozen corn snow at lower altitude, with wind. Thunder & lightning in the area.
Lot of coverage but definitely hot spring conditions
snowbird.author: Henri

snowbird.text: Shockingly good considering it was 75 degrees.  Still great cover.  Tee shirt and sun screen.

alta.text: Best sking, coverage, Vibe that's still a thing in North America! Get here fast as they close Sunday! Actually stay
alta.author: Matty McC

alta.text: Epic after tax day trip!  Groom team deserves a raise!  Great runs all over the mountain
alta.author: TDLL

alta.text: Amazing cover for mid April considering the winter.  The grooming team did a great job - tons groomed.  Get out and enjoy the last week.
Brief shutdown for thunder at lunch.   Alf's filled up quickly.
alta.author: Donny J

alta.text: Heat wet snow, but should make for good conditions later in the week and the weekend.
Lotsa snow today.  Baron loved it.
alta.author: Trump

brighton.text: Went this morning April 11th. The groomed runs were fun and fine. Good vibes. The snow on the non-groomed runs was rock solid and not fun to ski on. The snow in the trees around mid day was scary and sticky making it hard to turn.
Very slushy in the sun, most people wearing t-shirts with their snow pants. In the shade or at night the slush started forming ice. Starting to have some spots with low coverage.
Very sunny day, but overall the snow was really good, some powder stashes but great western is starting to get tracked out and icy.
Good stuff. Lots of goodies to be had.
Tons of powder. Way more than on the snow predicted
brighton.author: Parker Jones

brighton.text: A little crunchy with a little fresh powder on top
A little slushy with some fresh powder on top

50/50 rain snow mix.  Wet lift rides but snow was soft in the trees at the top of Great Western.  Fun fast riding today in mash potato ish conditions.  Changed to mostly light snow by 5 pm and started sticking to the trees.
brighton.author: El hodge

solitude.text: Yesterday at Summit things started a bit crusty but stayed more scalable than Apex and moonbeam.  Sunrise was also pretty decent.
solitude.author: Markny

solitude.text: A spectacular bluebird day. Although the locals we rode the chair with complained….those of us who flew in for the week were quite happy.
solitude.author: Uncle Rico’s Kitchen

solitude.text: It’s not powder, but there is snow falling. Maybe an inch accumulation near the top.  Prob too warm at bottom to stick
solitude.author: MC

solitude.text: Very icy on most of mtn except the couple of green run at the bottom
Great powder today and ok lines. Great time
Solitude should use more snow like all Rocky Mountain resorts, but it’s much better than I was expecting. Great coverage even on Blacks, and lift lines/people are minimal.
solitude.author: Matthew

solitude.text: Definitely NOT a powder day! Despite the 3 to 4 inches of snow overnight and, unless you got out there at 0900 when the visibility was poor, the conditions on the mid and lower mountain were awful. The snow was really choppy.  By noon, even the easier runs were icy, chopped up and the approaches to the lifts were sticky and slippery ...if that's even possible. I love Solitude but this was not a fun day. It's been a rough season and I know it will get better with more snow to come
Very nice day. So far no real powdery or icy conditions. No one is here
solitude.author: Marc S

snowbasin.text: Soft snow top half of the mountain, hard pack at the bottom.
snowbasin.author: T. Fox

snowbasin.text: Visibility isn't that great, but I'm still having a good time here at Snowbasin!
snowbasin.author: John Rowe uswest.ski

snowbasin.text: Well, I rolled in from Canada expecting snow turned out to be a very beautiful SnowBasin day minimalize easy to navigate lots of speed today snowboarding on Corey Smiths boards used to slush slasher most of the day. This board was made for days like today. Great fun pray for Snow. SnowBasin is super excellent. In fact very terrific.
snowbasin.author: Drts

snowbasin.text: Fog at top, bit of a break mid-mountain, rain at bottom.  Slushy snow throughout.  Good portion of the mountain closed due to the variable conditions.  Rough season but still one of my favorite Utah hills.
snowbasin.author: Jimmy G

snowbasin.text: Pretty solid powder day yesterday with patches of rock. Those going up middle bowl
snowbasin.author: Mitch

snowbasin.text: Beautiful day at the mountain. Spring skiing
Groomers are ripping surprisingly well given lack of snow, very few icy spots. Off the groomers has very sketchy coverage.

There Jan 18 and 19. Beautiful sunny days but they need snow badly. Strawberry all closed. Runs are now hard pack or icy. Lines not long at all. The views are mainly brown mountains as opposed to snow capped
snowbasin.author: Rus

powder-mountain.text: Great powder I recommend going right after a storm like 1-2 day after it will be powder but if not really icy
powder-mountain.author: Cole fife

powder-mountain.text: Powder mountain lived up to their name, fresh tracks everywhere.  Lift lines were bad at first but then they got people working the lines and ran much better.
powder-mountain.author: Schu

powder-mountain.text: Dumped all day.  Zero visibility but fresh tracks everywhere.   Don’t come tomorrow- I’m sure it’ll be terrible.
powder-mountain.author: Beef

powder-mountain.text: Slight dusting of snow made conditions slightly better, but still quite limited to groomers able to ski off piste a bit
powder-mountain.author: Adam

jackson-hole.text: Great powder in the morning but watch for ice hiding underneath. Pretty windy around noon with some lift stops for high winds. Way better conditions than I deserve.
Hardpack in the Wallyworld trees. Slushy mogul-fields on the way to the Sublette lift.
Mashed Potatoes. Snow is disappearing fast and what’s left is not good.

A lot of snow, good soft deep snow, at the top of the mountain. Not abnormal as I heard a lot of people say. The base area is mostly man made snow and nasty slush toward end of day at 30*F, mashed potatoes. The groomed stuff was hard pack down the middle of the runs and a lot of fun on a carver/slalom ski, but the same ski def not a good choice if you want to run up and down to the top.
Top down of the dropship is pretty icy and wind blown for the first 200 feet down on any direction, but mid mountain is a bluebird day littered with pockets of decent pow. Worth the trip
jackson-hole.author: SportsCarSkiBum

jackson-hole.text: Awesome conditions across the mountain today. Deep pow everywhere, a few icy spots down low. Corberts Coulier was great too
jackson-hole.author: Chris Ouellette

jackson-hole.text: Cold sunshine and fresh snow.  Great day today.
jackson-hole.author: Gregory James

jackson-hole.text: Skied March 9.  Top 1/3 of mountain was pretty nice.  Mid mountain was soft, spring skiing.  Bottom 1/3 of mountain was pretty terrible.  Felt bad for the ski school folks trying to learn how to ski through soup.

grand-targhee.text: Blue bird day with temps hovering around 46° at the base. Groomers are soft. Anything off piste are a little crunchy and icy. Not going to let it ruin our day, though. Typical spring skiing with a good base cover everywhere.
It’s been coming down since lunch. Turned out to be a wonderful day! Still snowing at 5 PM.
grand-targhee.author: Dawn

grand-targhee.text: The freshies were just what the ghee needed. Light floaty snow. Mostly overcast, on & off sun shower with snow storm that came in at 1p.
grand-targhee.author: Munchie

grand-targhee.text: Sunny morning, snowy afternoon. Plenty of free refills all day. Sacajawea had the best conditions in my experience. The blues were cruisin’. After hours snowfalls makes Good Friday.
grand-targhee.author: Munchie

grand-targhee.text: Whenever a chance to see the Teets! Today was the day. Great to share with a first timer and see their same admiration. Respect the mountain and its beauty! The groomers were great!
grand-targhee.author: Munchie

grand-targhee.text: Snow is still good. Beautiful bluebird day! Shaded areas are starting to become icy and low areas are starting to get soft. Warmer temps by the Sacajawea lift & lower traverses getting wet snow.
grand-targhee.author: Munchie

grand-targhee.text: Solid groomers, soft bumps, heavy snow
Powder trees -  Ghee don't ever change !
grand-targhee.author: Pookie pickle

grand-targhee.text: Powders still hanging out in the trees
grand-targhee.author: Ben

sun-valley.text: Nice (hard) hike up to the Round House.  Temp 65 degrees yet feels like 55 degrees.  Some dark clouds, wind gusts but no lightning threat.  Gondola still running….thus a FREE ride down!!!!
sun-valley.author: Paul

sun-valley.text: Don’t let the relatively low snow season fool you- the skiing here has been fantastic!
sun-valley.author: Tom

sun-valley.text: This was 2 days ago- tomorrow supposed to be sunny- much better snow than in Co
Sunny beautiful grippy snow after two days of powder.
Saturday February 14th. Very firm to icy base with a layer of man made snow on top that would get pushed into piles as the day went on.  Difficult to hold an edge with any confidence.

Remarkably good for no snow in a long time. I’d call it packed powder with some thin/icy/skied off spots. Good, firm and consistent first thing. Pretty much groomers only, occasional bumps in the sun although mostly those are very firm.  Sun and traffic loosens it up; no sun would make for icy day. Many south facing slopes have no snow at all. Been low wind and temps around 40.
sun-valley.author: Dave

sun-valley.text: From whence we came….  Bowls are beautiful. One buddy on lift described snow as chopped chowder, windswept in places, but it moved. Cold and clear today! Awesome views
sun-valley.author: kipr7

sun-valley.text: Great sunshine and views but pretty icy all round on mid and upper mountain. First time skiing the mountain, not sure it would be on my list of ‘must ski’ places to visit but an ok day out. I do think the lodges did a great job with food options. Definite A+
sun-valley.author: J.P.

sun-valley.text: Lots of snow up top and low visibility. Windy. Will be great when it cools down a bit. Upper limelight was the best run. Lower half wet
sun-valley.author: BadBrad

sun-valley.text: Looks like fun at the top!
sun-valley.author: Mart Man

big-sky.text: This is the most wonderful, fantastic, amazing, beautiful, and intricate ski resort I’ve ever been to. Also powder is 10/10.
big-sky.author: Yeti.dog.customer.

big-sky.text: Ideal spring conditions!  Fresh snow this past week breaking to sunny skies and pleasant temps°.
Foot n a half of pow off the shedhorn lift on 4/3. Basically knee deep. I hear it's the best day of the season

Big Sky is great place but not when 66% of the mountain is closed. Forcing skiers into a funnel and bottle neck is going to get kids hurt… no reason to close most of the mountain when you’ve had a bunch of new snow for a consistent week now
Amazing powder day, getting fresh 1.5 foot deep lines off of Challenger. The glades were all steep and deep, finally got the big mountain experience after a week of spring skiing.
big-sky.author: Ponderosa Pine

big-sky.text: Was supposed to be 1-2 inches, ended up snowing all day. Winter is back for Big Sky
big-sky.author: Sebastian

big-sky.text: The conditions today were surprisingly great! Many spots had thin cover, but Big Couloir, Castro’s, and Obsidian were all open at some point in the day! While I did not check out Big Couloir or Castro’s, Obsidian had a decent snow pack with decent quality. Other runs, mainly blues that were normally groomed, grew moguls towards the end of the day. For an advanced skier, this is almost as good as it gets.
big-sky.author: Myles

big-sky.text: Groomers went on strike!!! Worst skiing

“Springing it up in the bowl today with ms Flo Mingo” most lifts are running and the snow is soft. Early runs with 2-3” of night pow still falling. This week with four days of ski and two days of mid afternoon snow made the diamond runs and blue squares an exhilarating adventure. First time to the BigSky so will be back.
big-sky.author: B-Woods Charley Ferguson

taos.text: Last day of the year for me☹️
taos.author: Last Day!

taos.text: Beautiful summer day on the slopes.
taos.author: Summer Day

taos.text: Corduroy in the early morning - then sunny mash potatoes and slush until 4.
taos.author: Bob Kansas

taos.text: Conditions decent as there is literally zero snow and temps going up to the 80’s today
taos.author: Late Spring Conditions

taos.text: snow is not bad, but damn, the wind holds! yesterday and today most of the mountain was shut down/inaccessible for the afternoon because of wind
One run softer than the next.  Really.  Get a grip pal. Get a grip
taos.author: Steve

taos.text: Started snowing around 11 today. Every run was softer than the last. Let it snow!
Taos now (Dec 30th) reporting 11/13 lifts and 21/120 runs open
taos.author: Scott Skelton

wolf-creek.text: 65° on the mtn today. Pretty rough conditions unfortunately.......

Near white to white out on upper runs. Visibility good on lower slopes. Enough snow to cover most runs very well except black diamond sleeps still reveal icy mogul underneath a bit. Should be even better tomorrow. Hasn't stopped snowing since I got here around 9:30 am MT.
wolf-creek.author: Charles C Williams

wolf-creek.text: Typical spring skiing. Decent up top and in the trees
Beautiful views from the Alberta/Elma. Pretty typical Spring skiing. Little icy in the morn, little slushy in the afternoon. Still a lot of snow to rip.
Yeah there was snow everywhere at Wolf Creek today. And low winds and a clear blue sky. This is one we will remember for a while!
wolf-creek.author: Me and 2 of my sons

wolf-creek.text: Friday brought in two to three inches of fresh snow. Conditions were nothing to complain about and the various groups were having fun skiing the full mountain. Nice powder in the trees off of Alberta (2/13). Crowds weren’t too crazy for the holiday weekend.
wolf-creek.author: Skylar the Snow Shark

revelstoke.text: Pretty dang good, fresh in north bowl, slushy in lower mtn tho
revelstoke.author: Bos dude yt

revelstoke.text: Longline to get up, but so worth it. It was epic. Tons of powder.
1 hr 15 min to get from bottom to top of 2nd gondola
huge crowd One way up the mountain long line everyone knows it snowed
Snow was fabulous off the stoked chair today great terrain great snow lots of vertical to be had
revelstoke.author: Jesse

revelstoke.text: Today was brutal! It rained last night even at higher elevations and then froze up. World Cup Super G courses have nothing on Revelstoke today. Stoke chair is down until at least Wednesday. Recommend alternative plans until then at least.
revelstoke.author: Rick

revelstoke.text: Great snow for building snowmen. Rain at lower elevations and wet snow up top. The Stoke Chair not running. Everyone is at Ripper, long lines
revelstoke.author: Bruce O

revelstoke.text: With Stoke chair not running and freeze levels high on the mountain, everyone is crammed onto the Stellar chair. Snow held up remarkably well on groomers and in trees but not worth a visit until Stoke is running.
revelstoke.author: Jared B.

revelstoke.text: A fresh 5 in made this mountain wonderful today. Anything up top is awesome halfway down was pretty good. Spring conditions down low.
revelstoke.author: CC

revelstoke.text: Bleibt zu Hause! Es ist extrem voll.
revelstoke.author: MaikelSurf

whistler.text: Blackcomb is still open for3  more weeks
whistler.author: ERTZ

whistler.text: A little ice on Blackcomb, decent enough on Whistler. Not much available off groomers, but side hits still mostly available!
whistler.author: Strey Dawg

whistler.text: Glorious day at Whistler Blackcomb! After several inches of fresh snow accumulation and breaks of sunshine, the mountains finally delivered this week.
whistler.author: Yellobird

whistler.text: Major storm no visibility up high. Snow is piling up on top of a frozen crust layer.
whistler.author: NS Chiz

whistler.text: Early entries to the pond skim, got really busy later, good times
whistler.author: Hk

whistler.text: April Skiing was in effect. The weather was awesome though! Snow was slushy and heavy, but at least no ice!
whistler.author: Ethan

whistler.text: Still can make it to the bottom on skis.
whistler.author: Hk

whistler.text: Started to soften around 11am then good !! Beautiful day
whistler.author: Hk

whistler.text: Firm morning groomers. Soft snow in the afternoon. Alpine was great. Mid mountain was slush by the afternoon. Had an amazing three days!

lake-louise.text: Very good conditions from 9 am to 1 pm but slushy and slow after that. Good coverage on the single blacks I rode.
lake-louise.author: Jim Hill

lake-louise.text: Time for Louise Ownership and Management to re think May Skiing. Yesterday afternoon was dangerously bad with edges grabbing like crazy. So hard to keep yourself upright let alone trying to do much of anything else. I would fully recommend shutting down for the season at the end of April. And I don’t mean now I mean right now.
lake-louise.author: Mike Sugden

lake-louise.text: Had a great time today. Perfect spring conditions and plenty of snow.
lake-louise.author: Winston Waffles

lake-louise.text: Great spring conditions, Backside and West Bowl were in fine form in the afternoon.
lake-louise.author: M

lake-louise.text: Despite the snow depth, really hard packed and icy.  Wouldn't go back unless it was a warm sunny day to turn it into spring skiing.
lake-louise.author: Ricardo

lake-louise.text: Good late season conditions- mostly groomed and tracked out but no bare spots as there’s a ton of snowpack still.
lake-louise.author: Adam

lake-louise.text: Good conditions, packed, some icy patches.
Great conditions- still lots of fresh lines and minimal ice.
lake-louise.author: Adam

lake-louise.text: Great day with lots of recent snow.
lake-louise.author: Graham

kicking-horse.text: Ice/concrete at the top, slush at the bottom. Hoping it softens up this afternoon but for now the groomers are nice.
Sticky clumped up powder at the super bowl. Nicer pow in the bowl over area. Groomed at the bottom but still wet snow. Overall wet and foggy. Maybe some sun will come through later today.
On stairway to heaven... Snowing up top rain at bottom
At the base, more than 30 cm has fallen since 4 pm yesterday and still snowing at 8:30 am. (March12, 2026)
kicking-horse.author: GNH

kicking-horse.text: Great snow at Kicking Horse! Perfect temps for skiing.
kicking-horse.author: RG

kicking-horse.text: Top of the mountain had insane knee powder in some bowls. They opened T1 and Whitehall midway throughout
kicking-horse.author: Jesse

kicking-horse.text: It’s been dumping since midnight 20 to 30 cm up top. 12 to 15 cm lower mountain. The gondola and Stairway Chair have been in standby all morning due to high winds. Sun is peaking out now at 12 noon.
kicking-horse.author: GNH

kicking-horse.text: Couple cms of fresh snow on hard pack left behind.

It was so so good. Definitely stick to the north facing bowls but going out of your comfort zone really is what fav me the best experience a going to every bowl that you can just to further that experience.
kicking-horse.author: Alex

whiteface.text: Unbelievable bluebird day. Good conditions. Not too crowded
Beautiful day on the IceFace. Firm and fast as forecasted. But tolerable.
About a foot of fresh snow overnight. Temperatures around 25F -4C. Conditions look great, lines aren't too bad at all. Gondola photo.
whiteface.author: IanSR

whiteface.text: Pretty much packed powder, small lines, excellent conditions. Clearing skies made a beautiful day.
Extra cold this morning!  The wind is whipping and the lines are short. Not much ice and a good coating of powder.
Beautiful day. Some icy spots. Great vibes. Quick moving lines. Light snow most of today.
whiteface.author: K.P.

whiteface.text: Snow was great December 25-27. Mostly powder with a little ice. Did not see any trails closed.
Good conditions for such early season, snow guns running all day which I get but was a little tough to see. Overall great day headed back to get some more tomorrow.
whiteface.author: Darren

whiteface.text: Awesome powder day on Sunday, December 7.
whiteface.author: H.H.

whiteface.text: Sunday 11/30 limited terrain open but great conditions for this early in the season.

stowe.text: Pivoted from Park City and chased the snow to Vermont and were really pleasantly surprised. Conditions were much better than expected for early April, with excellent grooming that set up a firm, hard-packed morning that softened into really nice carvable snow by late morning. By the afternoon it turned into classic spring conditions with slush and some standing water at the base (especially near the Mansfield gondola), along with a few thin spots to watch for, but still plenty of fun moguls and soft snow to play on. Overall, a great day for a family — not perfect, but way better than expected for this time of year.
ice. ice and a dust of man made.
Bluebird day.  Gondola runs are epic
stowe.author: Danny

stowe.text: 3/24 packed pow bluebird sky. at end of day even though busy steep slopes got skied off you could find soft stuff all over.
stowe.author: Gasman

stowe.text: Beautiful day for skiing!  Fresh powder made our day.
Afternoon delight! 8" with some dropped ropes...
stowe.author: Shred

stowe.text: Currently dumping, little ice this morning when ski over , but now the fresh snow is making it really nice!
stowe.author: Jason

stowe.text: Decent amount of snowfall today, slopes have a nice amount of soft powder covering up some big patches of ice from the recent rain. Overall pretty solid conditions
Skied sat and sun, sat started with rain and fog, cleared and spring conditions. Sunday was sunny and warm. Spring skiing at its finest.
stowe.author: Your mom

killington.text: Big pile big whales by the end of day but still fun
killington.author: David

killington.text: Not a bad day w the kids! Mostly skied ramshead and the bubble. It flurried all day which made some sticky powder covering some of the ice patches by the end!  Lots of skiable runs still, and even my moderate-beginner son did ok today with the conditions on his snowboard. He don’t like the icy spots, but found plenty of good runs.
killington.author: Tammy (and kids)

killington.text: Ice skating rink . Dont come till it warms up
killington.author: Jeff k

killington.text: First time at Killington. Totally exceeded my expectations! Endless snowboarding and great conditions especially considering it's March 18, 2026.
killington.author: Mike

killington.text: Skied Tues through Friday Mar 13. Very warm and soft Tuesday and Wednesday, lost a lot of snow but there is still plenty left.  Thursday was solid ice and pretty bad but they did an excellent job of grooming for Friday to make it remarkably good for how bad it was on Thursday. Pic is from Wildfire on Friday morning .
killington.author: Arnie

killington.text: Hard pack but mostly decent skiing over the entire mountain (what was open). Icy patches and skied off by the end of the day. Left and right edges of all trails was good skiing. Let’s hope they get the 5” forecasted for tonight.
killington.author: Pete Helmus

killington.text: Nice spring conditions. A couple of bare patches but snow overall is quite good. Excellent day.
killington.author: Evel

jay-peak.text: Still solidly good snow! Hitting mid-day so more soft spots but overall holding up great.
jay-peak.author: Adam

jay-peak.text: Amazing day last Sat . Good coverage despite all the rain we got recently. With natural snow and man made, it’s looking like another great weekend !
jay-peak.author: Yves

jay-peak.text: Had a great day yesterday, blue sky warm sunny day. Thin cover was a bit of an understatement so bring your rock skies.
Kinda icy in some places and a bit slushy
jay-peak.author: Mjolls_skiz467

jay-peak.text: Great skiing over most of the mountain.  Jet was getting skied off by mid-morning.  Need to get Flyer lift open and take pressure off the tram - long, long lines.
jay-peak.author: Dr. Jay

jay-peak.text: Amazing powder today! Best turns all season
jay-peak.author: Larry Fernway

jay-peak.text: Tram and flyer are on wind hold, but there's great powder here on the stateside!
jay-peak.author: Aaron N

jay-peak.text: Variable conditions on all the blue groomers - changing every few feet between perfect fresh snow and hard ice.
jay-peak.author: H
